bindings.label: A 26-year-old female reported vision loss and metamorphopsia in her left eye over the past five days
Refractive error was -7.25 D in both eyes; best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 in the right eye and 20/40 in the left eye
Examination of the anterior chamber and vitreous cavity showed no signs of inflammation
Fundoscopy of the left eye revealed sporadic, small, round, yellow-white spots confined to the posterior pole, with no evidence of hemorrhage
SD-OCT shows focal ellipsoid zone elevation with hyper-reflective material in the left eye
SD-OCT shows intact RPE/Bruch's membrane and no choroidal neovascularization in the left eye
OCTA showed no choroidal neovascularization in the left eye
Acute idiopathic blind spot enlargement syndrome / other rare white dot syndromes
Confirmatory FAF, FA/ICGA, ERG, and uveitis serologies have not yet been obtained, so MEWDS remains unconfirmed and alternative white dot syndromes cannot be excluded
